# The Python tools scripts/export-edgetam.py, scripts/export-birefnet.py and
# scripts/export-ai-markers.py write the app's ONNX files with (Python 3.13, Linux x86_64, CPU only), every
# package pinned by version and SHA-256. Install with:
#
#   python3.13 -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r scripts/model-export-requirements.txt
#
# These are tools: none of them ends up in the files or in the app. Change one
# and the ONNX files may change byte for byte, so their pins in the app and the
# releases that serve them have to be made again (docs/MODELS.md).
#
# Made with:
#   uv pip compile in.txt --generate-hashes --python-version 3.13 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --no-header
# from these direct requirements:
#   torch==2.9.1
#   torchvision==0.24.1
#   onnx==1.23.2
#   onnxruntime==1.31.1
#   numpy==2.5.4
#   timm==1.0.15
#   hydra-core==1.3.8
#   iopath==0.1.10
#   pillow==13.0.0
#   tqdm==4.70.1
#   einops==0.8.2
#   kornia==0.9.0
#   huggingface_hub==2.4.0
#   opencv-python-headless==5.0.0.93
#   audioseal==0.2.1 (added by hand, its wheel only: its own requirements,
#   numpy, omegaconf, torch and einops, are all above)
